posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
Deep within the tombs buried beneath the Valley of Kings, a great evil stirs.  Once banished by the selfless actions of the Darkwatch, a horrific, dripping form rises from a shattered sarcophagus to clutch his pouch of bones once more!

Skinwalker Gloomweaver - ROUND 1

Gloomweaver (50) [Skinwalker]

In Play:
Pouch of Bones (25)

Start of Turn: n/a
   
Play: Crimson Pin (9)  Attaches to Ra.

End of Turn:
Gloomweaver deals Parse 4 melee damage (22).

========================
Effects:
- The first time a non-Villain target is destroyed each turn, play the top card of the Villain deck.

- When Gloomweaver would be destroyed, flip Gloomweaver's Villain character card instead.

- Damage dealt to Zombies (including Skinwalker Gloomweaver) is reduced by 1.  Whenever a Zombie enters play, each Villain target regains H (5) hp.

- At the end of XXXX hero's turn, Gloomweaver deals them H-2 (3) irreducible toxic damage. (Crimson Pin)

(Start of Turn)
- n/a

(End of Turn)
- At the end of the Villain turn, Gloomweaver deals the non-Villain target with the second lowest HP H-1 (4) melee damage.

==========
Gloomweaver  (50)  (DR 1)
Pouch of Bones (25)  
Crimson Pin (9) (Attached to Ra)
 

==========
Knyfe    - 30
Parse   - 22
The Naturalist    - 29
Omnitron-X - 25
Ra      - 30

===========
(none)
